arguments.code:
import json
# Login to file_system
password = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
file_system_token_resp = apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=password)
print(file_system_token_resp)

# List all files under ~/downloads recursively
fs_token = file_system_token_resp['access_token']
entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/downloads', entry_type='files', recursive=True, access_token=fs_token)
print('total_files', len(entries))
print('sample_files', entries[:20])

# Filter PDFs (case-insensitive)
pdf_files = [p for p in entries if isinstance(p,str) and p.lower().endswith('.pdf')]
print('pdf_files_count', len(pdf_files))
print('sample_pdf_files', pdf_files[:20])

# Delete all .pdf files found in ~/downloads
results = []
for path in pdf_files:
    resp = apis.file_system.delete_file(file_path=path, access_token=fs_token)
    results.append(resp)
print('deleted_count', len(results))
# Count successful deletions where response contains file_path
success_paths = [r.get('file_path') for r in results if isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('file_path')]
print('success_paths_count', len(success_paths))
print('first_5', success_paths[:5])
# Print any failures
failures = [r for r in results if isinstance(r,dict) and 'message' in r]
print('failures_count', len(failures))
print('failures_sample', failures[:3])
